skill.name: paperclip-board
skill.description: Manage a Paperclip company through its control-plane API. Support company onboarding, agent hiring, approvals, task tracking, cost oversight, and work-product review.
skill.summary: Run board operations for a Paperclip AI-agent company through conversational requests.

security_audit.summary: All 150 static findings are false positives: they match Markdown formatting, documentation, local loopback checks, or bounded Paperclip reset instructions rather than hidden execution or secret exposure. The skill still exposes broad board-management operations through a local trusted API mode and permits onboarding actions without a separate final confirmation.

remediation.issue: Local trusted mode grants board access without authentication.
remediation.suggestion: Bind trusted mode to loopback only, document the host trust boundary, and require authenticated mode for shared or network-accessible deployments.

remediation.issue: Onboarding guidance auto-approves a CEO hire and starts its heartbeat.
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicit user confirmation immediately before approval and heartbeat invocation, and show the proposed agent configuration and budget.

remediation.issue: Reset guidance uses a recursive deletion command.
remediation.suggestion: Require the user to confirm the resolved instance path and prefer a dedicated reset command that validates the target before deletion.

content.value_statement: Managing an AI-agent company can require many API calls and scattered operational checks. This skill turns board requests into structured Paperclip workflows for onboarding, approvals, monitoring, and review.
actual_capabilities: Create or select a Paperclip company and record its budget and mission.
Draft a hiring plan and maintain a decision log as Paperclip documents and local artifacts.
Prepare agent-hire requests, system prompts, and proposed escalation-path updates.
List, approve, reject, or request revisions for pending board approvals.
Monitor tasks, agents, budgets, costs, and work products through the Paperclip API.
Present operational status with concise summaries and web UI links.
limitations: Requires a running Paperclip server and configured API URL.
Does not install or bootstrap the Paperclip server itself.
Cannot guarantee API permissions, deployment security, or server availability.
High-impact actions should be reviewed and confirmed by an authorized board user.

use_cases.title: Launch a new agent company
use_cases.description: Create a company, establish governance, prepare a CEO hire, and start a decision log.

use_cases.title: Review a distributed agent team
use_cases.description: Check active agents, open tasks, pending approvals, and monthly spend in one board update.

use_cases.title: Plan a controlled expansion
use_cases.description: Draft a hiring plan, review agent prompts, and approve only the changes that meet governance requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Check board status
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the current company dashboard. Highlight blocked tasks, pending approvals, and budget concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Create a company plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a Paperclip company for a product research team. Ask for the mission and monthly budget before creating anything.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a hiring proposal
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a hiring plan for a designer and an engineer. Show the roles, budgets, reporting lines, and proposed system prompts for my review.

prompt_templates.title: Run a governance review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review pending approvals, agent costs, and blocked tasks. Recommend priorities, but ask for confirmation before approving, rejecting, or changing any record.

output: Company dashboard with active and paused agents

output_examples.input: Help me hire a product designer.
output: Draft role scope, budget, and reporting line
Proposed system prompt with boundaries and tool permissions
A request for approval before submitting the hire
Cost breakdown by agent and project

best_practices: Confirm the target company and review the dashboard before making changes.
Review proposed agent prompts, permissions, budgets, and approvals before submission.
Use authenticated Paperclip deployments when the service is shared or network-accessible.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to install or bootstrap the Paperclip server.
Do not approve hires or start agent heartbeats without authorized review.
Do not expose a local trusted Paperclip service to untrusted users or networks.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages Paperclip company onboarding, agents, approvals, tasks, costs, work products, and decision logs.

faq.question: Does this skill install Paperclip?
faq.answer: No. Use the Paperclip setup guidance to install or start the server first.

faq.question: What configuration is required?
faq.answer: A running Paperclip server, PAPERCLIP_API_URL, and usually an active company ID are required.

faq.question: Can it hire agents?
faq.answer: It can prepare and submit hire requests, including prompts, budgets, and governance steps.

faq.question: Can it approve changes automatically?
faq.answer: The source guidance includes onboarding auto-approval. Authorized users should require a final confirmation for consequential actions.

faq.question: Is local trusted mode safe for shared systems?
faq.answer: No. Use authenticated mode and restrict network access when other users or processes are not fully trusted.
